headline: Law bans entry of goods made with forced labor in the Dominican Republic
summary: The Chamber of Deputies approved and enacted a bill allowing the customs authority to ban goods made with forced labor. The law sets a procedure to investigate the origin of imported goods.
why: Import bans tied to forced labor affect global supply chains, and exporters to the Dominican Republic may need to document the origin of their goods.
original_headline: Ley prohíbe entrada de mercancías con trabajo forzoso en RD
